summary: Artillery Units represent crewed weapon platforms rather than ordinary infantry. They generally attack using a single Artillery profile, with one weak melee profile representing the crew's ability to defend the machine. Artillery cannot charge and has the Artillery tag.

specialUpgrades.name: Timed Barrage
specialUpgrades.availableTo: Heavy Artillery equipped with a Bombard
specialUpgrades.effect: When this Unit activates during the Movement Phase and there are other activations available, it may prepare a Timed Barrage instead of moving. At the end of the Movement Phase, provided the Unit remained stationary and unengaged, place a 25mm token within 15". Each Unit with at least half its current Models (rounded up) within 2" of the token suffers one automatic Physical Hit at Damage 1 total. Resolve Armor and applicable Ward; Evade does not apply. Friendly Units can be affected. The Unit cannot make its normal Bombard Attack during the following Assault Phase. Remove the token after resolving the effect.

secondaryWeapon.name: Crew Weapons
secondaryWeapon.notes: The artillery platform makes one melee Attack using this profile, regardless of the number of crew figures represented. All Artillery includes this.

units.battlefieldRole: Ranged fire support, siege warfare, attacking heavily armored targets, and area denial.
designNotes: v4 balance pass (post-playtesting): the Damage-1 Repeater Gun and Crew Weapons gained +1 Attack; all Damage-2/3 main weapons kept their listed Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] 2, diversified across Armored/Monster/Construct/Elite/Infantry categories to keep Artillery profiles distinct from one another.
